verdict.rationale: The product documents two update paths. The copied-files route has an explicit `npx skills update` command for pulling the latest changes on demand. The Claude Code and Codex plugin installs auto-update ("Updates itself by default" / "at startup"), and the ADR frames these as an always-current, read-only bundle. The runtime probe confirms the install path works, but no one has exercised the update path itself. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that `npx skills update` and the marketplace auto-update actually deliver fixes; documented update behavior for the Copilot plugin install.
